joi_block.name: Scenario

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 1초마다 거실 습도가 70% 이상이면 제습기 플러그를 켜고, 그렇지 않고 50% 이하이면 꺼줘.
command_eng: Every 1 second, if the living room humidity is at least 70%, turn on the dehumidifier plug; otherwise if it is 50% or below, turn off the dehumidifier plug.
